tables.dataset_summary: Successful U-bend design data in released coordinate/physical target units. Inputs are signed geometry parameters, pressure is Pa, and the cooling objective is K squared times m squared. No error-based trimming or global standardization is applied.
tables.split_counts: Exact row counts, identical across outer seeds. Random tests use their test set as ID evaluation; structured tests have a separate supported ID set. Joint stress tests deliberately exclude unused marginal-only cases.
tables.full_primary: U-bend U+D-max results, means over three full runs. Empty accepted sets have undefined retained metrics. All error columns are percentages.
tables.grouped: Random-design evaluation, three-run means and sample SD. Calibration uses a nominal 90% acceptance budget; measured test coverage is shown.
tables.supplied_random: Random-design evaluation, three-run means and sample SD. Calibration uses a nominal 90% acceptance budget; measured test coverage is shown.
tables.structured: Geometry-coordinate support shifts, defined before examining errors; low/high are endpoint support tests and middle is a missing interior slab. Means over three runs.
tables.gate_decisions: Binary calibrated acceptance/abstention. The warning tier is a separate retrospective diagnostic only.
tables.false_decisions: False accept and false abstain use all test rows as denominator; failure prevalence is tolerance defined. Tolerances are illustrative, not engineering standards.
tables.detection: Failure detection means over evaluable runs; undefined single-class detection metrics remain blank/--. Valid AUC run count is explicit.
tables.ablation: XGB score ablation on design-random tests. AURC is tie-aware and undefined for constant scores; it is a ranking diagnostic, not a risk guarantee.
tables.intervals: Seed 42; 500 resamples conditional on fitted model. One row per unique design. Six covariate-only KMeans strata give coarse descriptive bands, not confidence intervals for unseen physical geometry families.
tables.competitors: Point-selection risk and CQR interval coverage are different estimands. GP pressure point estimates are inverse-log medians, while tree ensemble estimates are physical-unit member means.
tables.matched_risk: MAPE at approximately 90% expected retained coverage, averaged over three runs. Random ordering inside ties may be unattainable by one deterministic cutoff.
tables.binary_sweep: XGB seed-42 sensitivity. Binary calibration quantiles vary the cutoff; tolerance sweeps vary failure labels without refitting or moving the cutoff.
tables.tolerances: XGB seed-42 sensitivity. Binary calibration quantiles vary the cutoff; tolerance sweeps vary failure labels without refitting or moving the cutoff.
tables.conformal_groups: CQR 90% intervals, three-run means. Each design contains one row, so row/design coverage coincide. Group exchangeability is hypothetical under Sobol sampling and does not hold automatically for imposed support shifts. Width is in physical target units.
tables.point_baselines: Original five point-regressor families on full outer training. These are context benchmarks, not training-budget-matched selective models; RMSE is in target units.
tables.fit_budget: Single ET on common fit versus full outer train and tune-selected converged SVR on common fit. Three-run means isolate training budget from selective scoring.
tables.sensitivity: Three-state diagnostic for XGB cooling objective, seed 42/design-random. Primary decisions are binary; no intermediate risk ordering is presumed.
tables.actual_thresholds: Independent 90th-percentile binary calibration cutoffs and actual test retention, seed 42. Unbounded scores permit cutoffs above one; cutoffs are not error-probability thresholds.
tables.error_distribution: Error-distribution summaries averaged over three runs. Symmetric APE is bounded by 200%; raw per-run quantiles, maxima and numerical guard counts are exported separately.
